However, refusing the fix and routing back to DEV despite a fixable in-scope issue is effectively a pause and conflicts with the historical DEV-to-REVIEW progression.

champion.notes: Preserves safety boundaries and proposes a strong exact-state regression, but its diagnosis leaves the failure unresolved across projection, validation, persistence, and rendering, contrary to the established projection/UI cause. Remaining in DEV without acting also effectively pauses a fixable issue.
